data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew 'Kesheth', meaning 'God's gift'. In the Bible, Kesheth is the name of a woman who is a gift from God to the prophet Hosea. The name Kessiah carries the meaning “God's gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kessiah usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Divine blessing, gift from the heavens.
data.etymology: Kessiah belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's gift.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kessiah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
